richiami.difetto: On the affected vehicles a holding ring on the cog rail of the directing mechanism might not be in the proper position. This could lead to a slight shift of the steering wheel which in extreme cases could cause reduction of the stability and the ability to steer the vehicle.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: OPEL:- Combo-C,-  Tigra-B, - Meriva-A. Vehicles have the following VIN numbers: - Combo-C: from 7 4 334708 to 7 4 379398, - Tigra-B: from 7 Ε 009713 to 7 Ε 010557, - Meriva-A: from 7 4 361448 to 7 4 423896.
